_note: 人形の盤面表示 (2026-09-19 ユーザー「盤面の人形のイラストは新規で pixellab で作成すること」)。白の従者11体を舞台に立たせるドット絵。32×32 (4px/ドット=128px・ひなた 224px の半分強)・south-east (右=敵の方を向く)・low top-down (舞台の見下ろしに合わせる)・背景なし。人形の定義は白のカード挿絵と同じ (cards-white-descriptions.json の doll)。出来たら unity/Assets/Resources/Art/dolls/<id>.png に入る = Creature.Get("dolls", id) が拾う。使い方: node scripts/pixellab.mjs gen docs/pixellab/dolls-stage.json [--only id] [--seed N] [--force]
style: Octopath Traveler HD-2D style pixel art character sprite, full body, standing on the ground, single character centered, muted palette where the warm amber eyes and brass trim are the only bright accents, polished brass and matte white iron as the materials, no text, no background
